rooms.name: Foyer and staircase
rooms.description: entrance corridor with white doors and wood-look floor, round boucle ottomans by a tall mirror, staircase to the second floor

rooms.name: Living room
rooms.description: white boucle couch, two cream armchairs, cream patterned rug, TV on a light wood console, black ceiling fan, floor lamp

rooms.name: Dining area
rooms.description: marble-look table with a black wire basket that stays as decor, boucle chairs, big windows to the backyard

rooms.name: Kitchen
rooms.description: white shaker cabinets, speckled grey granite, white subway tile, stainless double sink, glass-top range, over-the-range microwave, French-door fridge, white double step trash can

rooms.name: Powder room
rooms.description: white sink top with chrome faucet, grey framed mirror, towel ring, toilet with a bidet seat

rooms.name: Back porch
rooms.description: back porch by the sliding glass door: dark brown wood loveseat with grey seat cushions and a grey back pillow, armchair with light blue-green cushions, slatted wood coffee table, small wood side table, white rain barrel by the wall

rooms.name: Front porch
rooms.description: front porch at the black front door: brown wicker loveseat with light blue-green cushions and two white shell-shaped pillows, small rattan side table, white plant pot on a wood stand, coir doormat

rooms.name: Master bedroom
rooms.description: king bed with pink bedding and a wood headboard, a queen bed on a wooden platform by the window, gold floor mirror, reading chair and olive tree, grey carpet

rooms.name: Master bathroom
rooms.description: white and brown granite double vanity with a makeup counter, white tub with subway tile, separate toilet room with floating wood shelves

rooms.name: Bedroom 1
rooms.description: bed with a rattan headboard, small white kids table with two chairs and a globe, grey carpet

rooms.name: Bedroom 2
rooms.description: single bed with a pink patterned pillow, brown boucle bean bag chair, grey carpet

rooms.name: Hall bathroom
rooms.description: shared upstairs bath: speckled grey granite vanity with two towel rings, tub with subway tile and a white shower curtain, floating wood shelves over the toilet
